visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair wearing a light blue textured shirt and a man with glasses and a white t-shirt stand in front of a Japanese restaurant entrance. (2) The woman is indoors, wearing a different black-and-white checkered shirt, placing a heavy black electronic neck collar around her neck. (3) The woman walks excitedly towards the camera in a large indoor themed venue with a red-lit artificial sky and European-style architecture, labeled Immersive Fort Tokyo. (4) Close-up on the woman's chest as she points to a red glowing light on the electronic collar while standing before an 'Alice in Borderland' themed poster. (5) Various scenes of a crowd gathered in a dimly lit, blue-hued indoor plaza with theatrical lighting and a blond man in a patterned hoodie standing on an elevated platform. (6) The woman reacts with a pained expression as a yellow lightning bolt graphic overlays the screen, simulating an electric shock from the neck collar. (7) A white screen displays multilingual subtitles (English and Chinese) explaining the game mechanics, followed by a wall display of multiple game posters and schedules. (8) Exterior shot of the DiverCity Tokyo Plaza building under a cloudy sky, transitioning to a shopping mall interior where the woman browses shelves filled with merchandise. (9) The woman explores the 'Hello Kitty Japan' store, featuring a large Hello Kitty head hanging from the ceiling and shelves packed with colorful Sanrio characters. (10) Close-up shots of various products: character-themed keychains, Cinnamoroll and Pochacco hand creams, and lip balms in colorful packaging. (11) The woman operates a Kuromi-themed popcorn machine and later holds a bag of popcorn while eating a piece. (12) In the 'Rashinban' store, the woman walks past anime figures, specifically a blue Mega Man figure, and browses a wall of media cases. (13) The entrance to 'Tokyo Gourmet Stadium' is shown with a neon pink sign, followed by a high-resolution graphic of a shopping coupon with Japanese text. (14) Final shots show a man, woman, and toddler in a park setting, followed by the family waving inside a room.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman with short brown hair, wearing a light blue textured top and later a black-and-white checkered shirt with a blue shoulder bag.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between an indoor themed park (Immersive Fort Tokyo) with elaborate street-style sets and artificial skies, and a modern shopping mall (DiverCity Tokyo Plaza) featuring brightly lit retail stores, anime merchandise, and a food court.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-paced acoustic guitar track. A female voice speaks with high energy and a friendly tone. Background chatter from a crowd is subtly audible. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX signals a transition. The vocal delivery speed increases as the speaker describes an immersive game experience. A low-frequency riser SFX adds dramatic tension. (3) An electrical zap sound effect coincides with the visual shock graphic. The female speaker reacts with a playful shout and laughter, followed by a 'whoosh' transition SFX. (4) The BGM shifts slightly to a more bubbly, upbeat pop rhythm as the location changes to a shopping mall. Soft incidental rustling of bags is audible behind the narration. (5) A digital UI 'click' sound accompanies the mention of a coupon. The female voice maintains a clear, professional narrative style while explaining the discount details. (6) The video concludes with the acoustic guitar track fading out under the speaker's final greeting and a hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Theme Park -> Shopping Mall Walkthrough -> Product Showcase -> Coupon Offer -> Outro.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Tokyo as a travel destination by showcasing a unique immersive theme park based on 'Alice in Borderland' and a variety of shopping experiences at DiverCity Tokyo Plaza, ultimately incentivizing viewers with an exclusive discount coupon.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of shopping locations and the provision of an exclusive 1,000 JPY discount coupon for DiverCity Tokyo Plaza.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines high-arousal entertainment coverage with practical shopping information and a clear call-to-action via the coupon.
